learn.hook: A village collected 1250 kg of plastic in March and 1475 kg in April. What a clean-up! How much in all?
points: Write the numbers one below the other: ones under ones, tens under tens, and so on.
Start adding from the ones place, then tens, hundreds and thousands.
If a place adds up to 10 or more, write the ones digit and carry 1 to the next place.
Check your answer by estimating: 1250 + 1475 is about 1300 + 1500 = 2800, so 2725 makes sense.
learn.reallife: Village panchayats add up the waste collected each month to see how clean the village is getting.

quiz.mistake: Takes away instead of adding (gets 1111)
Forgets to add the carried 1

quiz.q: The village collected 1250 kg of plastic in March and 1475 kg in April. How much plastic is that altogether?
quiz.mistake: Forgets to carry from the tens place
Forgets the carry into the thousands place

quiz.q: Find the missing number: ___ + 2500 = 6000
quiz.mistake: Adds 2500 to 6000 instead of finding the difference

quiz.explain: 2000 + 2000 = 4000. We added 1 extra twice, so take away 2: 3998.
quiz.mistake: Rounds both numbers to 2000 and forgets to take back the extra

quiz.q: Three wards cleaned 1200 m, 350 m and 45 m of drains. How many metres in all?
quiz.mistake: Lines up the numbers from the left instead of the right

quiz.q: About how much is 2980 + 4030? Choose the best estimate.
quiz.mistake: Rounds one number the wrong way

teach.ask: Gappu added 4678 + 2516 and got 6184. What did Gappu forget?
teach.praise: Oh! When a place makes 10 or more, Gappu must carry 1 to the next place. The answer is 7194!
teach.nudge: What happens when 8 + 6 makes 14? Where does the extra ten go?

learn.hook: The village had 4500 trees. 1250 were planted this year. How many are old? Subtraction to the rescue!
points: Write the bigger number on top. Line up ones, tens, hundreds and thousands.
Start from the ones place. If the top digit is smaller, borrow 1 from the next place (it becomes 10 here).
With zeros, like 6000 - 2475, borrow across: 6000 becomes 5 thousands, 9 hundreds, 9 tens and 10 ones.
Check subtraction by adding: answer + number taken away = the starting number.

steps: Tens: 0 became 9 after borrowing from hundreds. 9 - 6 = 3.

learn.reallife: Shopkeepers subtract to give change, and the gram sabha subtracts to see how much money is left for cleaning tools.

games.title: Check by adding
items: Adding back gives the starting number, so it is correct.
In 7302 - 4568, we must borrow in the ones place.
2 is less than 8, so we borrow.
When we borrow, the top digit gets 100 more.
It gets 10 more, because 1 from the next place is 10 here.

quiz.mistake: Adds instead of subtracting (8023)

quiz.explain: Borrow across the zeros: 6000 is 5 thousands, 9 hundreds, 9 tens and 10 ones. 10 - 5 = 5, 9 - 7 = 2, 9 - 4 = 5, 5 - 2 = 3. So 3525.
quiz.mistake: Forgets that borrowing makes the thousands digit 1 less
Takes the smaller digit from the bigger one in every place (gets 3266)

quiz.q: The village has 4500 trees. 1250 of them were planted this year. How many trees are older?
quiz.mistake: Adds the numbers instead of subtracting

quiz.q: Find the missing number: 8000 - ___ = 3200
Riya worked out 5420 - 1385 = 4035. To check, she adds 4035 + 1385. What should she get?
quiz.explain: If the subtraction is right, adding back gives the start number. 4035 + 1385 = 5420.
quiz.mistake: Does not know that addition undoes subtraction

quiz.q: How much more is 9000 than 6750?
quiz.mistake: Makes a borrowing mistake and gets 3250

quiz.q: Meena had ₹2000. She spent ₹1345 on cleaning brooms and buckets. How much money is left?
quiz.mistake: Forgets to reduce digits after borrowing across zeros

teach.ask: Gappu tried 6000 - 2475 but cannot take 5 from 0. What should Gappu do?
teach.praise: Yes! Borrow across the zeros, subtract, and add back to check. Gappu got 3525!
teach.nudge: When the top digit is 0, where can Gappu get some more from?

learn.hook: A good problem-solver first asks: should I add or subtract? Let's learn the clue words!
points: Read the problem twice. Find what is given and what is asked.
Words like 'altogether', 'in all' and 'total' usually mean add.
Words like 'how many more', 'how many left' and 'difference' usually mean subtract.
Some problems have two steps. Do one step at a time.
Check if your answer makes sense.

example.q: A village had 2500 plants. The children planted 1200 more, but 300 dried up. How many plants are there now?

learn.reallife: Swachh Bharat drives count how many bags were filled and how many are still left to fill.

items.text: 1235 children and 1180 children march in a rally. In all, ___ children march.
A train has 1200 seats. 875 are booked. ___ seats are empty.
The goal is 6000 kg. 4800 kg is done. ___ kg more is needed.

quiz.q: Green village has 1345 people and Blue village has 2678 people. How many people live in both villages?
quiz.mistake: Forgets one of the carries

quiz.q: Children collected 3250 bottles. 1875 have been sent for recycling. How many are not yet sent?
quiz.explain: 'Not yet sent' means what is left. 3250 - 1875 = 1375.
quiz.mistake: Adds the numbers instead of subtracting

quiz.q: 'How many more' in a word problem usually tells you to do what?
quiz.explain: 'How many more' asks for the difference between two numbers, so we subtract.
quiz.mistake: Sees the word 'more' and thinks it means add

quiz.q: A village had 2500 plants. Children planted 1200 more, but 300 dried up. How many plants are there now?
quiz.mistake: Does only the first step, or adds the 300 too

quiz.q: The compost pit made 1450 kg of compost in Week 1 and 1650 kg in Week 2. How much more was made in Week 2?
quiz.mistake: Adds both weeks instead of finding the difference

quiz.q: A train has 1200 seats. 875 seats are booked. How many seats are still empty?
quiz.mistake: Makes a borrowing mistake and gets 425

quiz.q: Aisha's village wants to collect 6000 kg of waste for recycling. It has collected 4800 kg. How much more is needed?
quiz.mistake: Adds the goal and what is collected

quiz.q: School A sent 1235 children and School B sent 1180 children to a cleanliness rally. How many children joined in all?
quiz.mistake: Forgets the carry from the tens, or subtracts

teach.ask: Gappu reads a story sum but doesn't know whether to add or subtract. Which words give a clue?
teach.praise: Thank you! 'In all' means add and 'how many left' means subtract. Gappu can solve story sums now!
teach.nudge: Which words tell Gappu to add? Which words tell Gappu to take away?
